title: King Von to Chairman Mao takes only five photos
description: Five real photos link Chicago rapper King Von to Mao Zedong, through Lil Durk, Kanye West, Donald Trump and Henry Kissinger.
hook: How is King Von connected to Mao Zedong?

links.line: In 2018, Lil Durk signed King Von to his label OTF, and the two Chicago rappers became inseparable.
Durk idolizes Kanye West, even naming a 2021 song Kanye Krazy, and the two have hung out.

image.credit: Seth Wenig / AP, via ABC7 New York

links.line: In December 2016, Kanye visited President-elect Donald Trump at Trump Tower in New York.

image.file: File:President Trump Meets with Henry Kissinger (33787724293).jpg

links.line: Months later, President Trump hosted Henry Kissinger, the diplomat who opened America's door to China.
And in 1975 in Beijing, Kissinger shook hands with Chairman Mao Zedong himself.
